decision_limit: May motivate a separately preregistered experiment; may not alter either frozen score, select candidate-v2, or support an official-test claim.

method.membership: Require the same 756 unique sample IDs in the development manifest and both score files.
method.value_only_failure: A wrong prediction whose decision, mode, call count, call order, tool names, and per-call argument-key sets match gold; one or more argument values differ.
method.aligned_argument_mismatch: For aligned gold/prediction call indices, count each shared argument key whose value differs. Structural errors remain failures but do not invent missing value pairs.
method.calendar_datetime: Compare each create_calendar_event datetime at its gold call index. A cross-month occurrence has a gold YYYY-MM different from the prompt's sole NOW YYYY-MM.
method.now_month_copy: The predicted datetime YYYY-MM equals the prompt's sole NOW YYYY-MM.

interpretation: The dominant BarunAction error is a deterministic NOW-month shortcut in calendar datetime values. Map query mismatches are nearly tied at 33 versus 34, so month-boundary counterevidence is the narrower next intervention. These reused development rows diagnose the failure and cannot validate its repair.
